clue.text: Former pupil, legal scholar, in the side moving unsteadily

indicators.note: the two qualifications are placed inside the word for a side of a team

parts.note: a wing is a side, as of a building or a team
OB, old boy, is a former pupil of a school
BL is a Bachelor of Law, someone who has studied law

explanation.surface: An old boy who studied law plays in the team and staggers about.
explanation.definitionFit: To wobble is to rock or sway, so anything wobbling is moving unsteadily.

clue.text: Now he elopes, pocketing ring

indicators.note: the phrase Now he elopes holds the answer within its letters, as a pocket holds something

explanation.surface: A man runs off to marry now, with a ring in his pocket.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the gap from 'Now' through 'he' into 'elopes'.
explanation.definitionFit: A circle or hoop is a ring shape, and a round disc on an axle is the classic such hoop.

clue.text: Coming from Broadmoor to place where decisions are made

indicators.note: the letters of Broadmoor are reworked to produce something new from them

explanation.surface: Someone travels from Broadmoor, a high-security psychiatric hospital in England, to a place of decision-making.
explanation.definitionFit: A company's board meets in its own room, and that is where corporate decisions are taken.

clue.text: I name old work that's rough

parts.note: ex means former or old, as in an ex-wife
an act is a deed or piece of work

explanation.surface: Someone names an old piece of work and admits it was rough.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough estimate is approximate, not precise, which is the same idea as imprecise.

clue.text: Progress smoothly on tick?

parts.note: the idiom for running without a hitch, read literally as advancing tick by tick like a mechanism driven by a spring

explanation.walkthrough: 'On tick' also suggests buying on credit, a misleading British sense; here it is the ticking of a timepiece.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to run perfectly smoothly, like a well-made wound-spring mechanism keeping time.

clue.text: Rotten place, one getting in the way

parts.note: to place something is to put it somewhere

indicators.note: the letter for one enters the abbreviation for way, splitting it

parts.note: RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A rotten place, with someone standing in the way.
explanation.definitionFit: Decayed and foul-smelling things are rotten; putrid describes decomposing matter.

clue.text: Criticise expert with a universal medicine

parts.note: to pan a show is to criticise it harshly
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: Someone attacks an expert who touts a cure-all medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: A cure-all remedy for every illness is the meaning of this Greek-derived word.

clue.text: Reprint acceptable in different series

indicators.note: the letter for acceptable is placed within the rearranged letters
the letters of series are made different by rearranging them

parts.note: U means upper-class, hence socially acceptable

explanation.surface: A publisher's reprint is acceptable if issued in a different series.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different' turns SERIES into REISSE, and 'in' puts U inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Printing a book again, or a new edition of it, is to issue it once more.

clue.text: Cannibalistic competition?

parts.note: ruthless rivalry where canines devour one another, taking the idiom literally

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes ruthless contests where rivals destroy each other, pictured as animals eating their own kind.

clue.text: Three notes, one repeated before one has to rub out

indicators.note: the notes come before the word for one in the answer

parts.note: E and F are musical notes

indicators.note: one of the notes appears twice to make three notes in all

parts.note: F is another musical note
an ace is a one in cards

explanation.surface: A musical sequence of three notes, one doubled, before a single note must be erased.
explanation.walkthrough: The three notes are E, F, F: 'one repeated' doubles F.
explanation.definitionFit: To erase or wipe away all trace of something is to efface it.

clue.text: Starting proceedings without American, taking food

indicators.note: the letter for American is dropped from the word for starting proceedings

parts.note: launching means starting something off

explanation.surface: An event is started without the American, and everyone sits down to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Eating the midday meal is taking food at noon.

clue.text: Set out and returned relaxed

parts.note: a table that is laid has been set out
someone back has returned

explanation.surface: Someone set off and came home in a calm frame of mind.
explanation.definitionFit: An easygoing, unhurried manner is described by this informal compound.

clue.text: Plant carrier inside spy organisation

indicators.note: the beast of burden goes inside the initials of the agency

parts.note: the CIA is the US intelligence agency
an ass carries loads as a pack animal

explanation.surface: A spy agency has planted a carrier inside its organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a genus of shrubs and trees, one of which gives a cinnamon-like bark.

clue.text: Coasting casually as a 'don't know'

indicators.note: the letters of Coasting are rearranged in a loose, haphazard way

explanation.surface: Someone drifting along without effort answers 'don't know' when asked.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who holds that God's existence cannot be known is effectively a religious 'don't know'.

clue.text: Cur Laura and I stupidly told privately

indicators.note: the letters of the three words are jumbled in a senseless way

explanation.surface: A dog, Laura and the speaker act foolishly.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the ear, as in auricular confession: something whispered into the ear is told in private.

clue.text: Add a couple of pages with piece left over

parts.note: PP is the abbreviation for pages, two P's
an end, as in odds and ends or a loaf end, is a leftover piece

explanation.surface: Instructions for adding a couple of pages and a remaining scrap.
explanation.definitionFit: To attach or tack something on at the end is to add it.

clue.text: No end of science in a new form for doctor

indicators.note: the last letter of the science is cut off

parts.note: physics is a science

indicators.note: the two short words are rearranged into another form

explanation.surface: Science, endlessly reworked, produces a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No end of' trims PHYSICS to PHYSIC; 'new form' turns IN A into IAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical practitioner or doctor is a physician.

clue.text: One imagining diamonds dropped tool

indicators.note: the card-suit letter is left out of the word

parts.note: a dreamer is one who imagines
D is the abbreviation for the suit diamonds

explanation.surface: A daydreamer lets his diamonds fall to the floor along with a tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A boring tool used to enlarge or smooth holes is a specific kind of implement.

clue.text: One still without polarity

parts.note: A means one, a single thing
static means still, not moving

explanation.surface: A magnet that stays put has lost its polarity.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics, a needle unaffected by Earth's magnetic field has no directional poles.

clue.text: Pitched battle arbitrator?

parts.note: a pitched battle read as a contest on a sports pitch, whose arbitrator is the match official

explanation.definitionFit: The official who adjudicates a match played on a football or rugby pitch is the arbitrator of that contest.

clue.text: Wrong being dishonest away from the centre

parts.note: out means wrong, as in an estimate that is out
lying is being dishonest

explanation.surface: Someone is wrong to tell lies about being away from the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Remote, situated far from the centre, as outlying villages are.

clue.text: Number having the necessary power can be defended

parts.note: ten is a number
able means having the power or capacity to do something

explanation.surface: A force strong enough in numbers can hold its position.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenable position is one that can be held or maintained against attack.

clue.text: Copper to play very loudly and end abruptly

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
taken as written
ff, fortissimo, is the musical instruction to play very loudly

explanation.surface: A policeman blasts out music and then stops suddenly.
explanation.definitionFit: To terminate or halt sharply, as a call or supply, is this phrasal verb.

clue.text: Thousand joining, most dark and most twisted

indicators.note: the letter for a thousand joins the front of the superlative

parts.note: inkiest means blackest, most dark like ink

explanation.surface: A thousand people join in, darkest and most depraved.
explanation.definitionFit: Kinky can mean perverted as well as curly, so the superlative is most twisted in either sense.

clue.text: Part of body to inhibit a lustfulness inside

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of letters across the three words

explanation.surface: A body part is used to curb a person's lust.
explanation.definitionFit: The ankle bone joining the foot to the leg is an anatomical part of the body.

clue.text: Leaving New Zealand horizontal, excitable libertine

indicators.note: the country's letters leave the word before it is rearranged
the remaining letters are excited into a new order

explanation.surface: An excitable rake leaves New Zealand, lying down.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove N and Z from HORIZONTAL to leave HORIOTAL, then rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after the seducer in Rowe's play The Fair Penitent, the name stands for a womaniser or libertine.

clue.text: Said to be path of woman on way to union

definitions.text: of woman on way to union

indicators.note: the word heard is spoken, so its sound gives a different spelling

parts.note: a bridle path is a track for riding horses, so path suggests bridle

explanation.surface: The path a woman takes on the way to her wedding.
explanation.walkthrough: A bridle path is a British bridleway for horse riders.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to a bride, the woman going to her marriage union, as in bridal gown.

clue.text: Withdraw engineers' flag

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army
to flag is to yield or give way, as is to cede

explanation.surface: Engineers lower their flag and pull back.
explanation.definitionFit: To recede is to move back or retreat, which is to withdraw.

clue.text: Professional wailer's eagerness?

parts.note: a keener is a hired mourner who keens or wails at funerals, so their quality is jokingly their eagerness

explanation.definitionFit: Eagerness or enthusiasm is the quality of being keen, punning on keening, an Irish lament for the dead.
